note: v2: the drift gets a shape (ground F Eb Db C, Risset pendulum, build)
v4: the hold an eighth apart on Ab, built on the eighth (hat eighths, ghost echo, bass on both guitars)
v6: the hold three sixteenths apart on B, the band only on the five coincidences
v8: the hold a sixteenth apart on C, kick and bass on every note of either guitar, the drummer in the three holes
v9: the right guitar chugs join with the bass and kick at bar 4; the band stops for the voice first word
v10: two clocks at the end, left and right, in opposition (and the snare out of the cymbals room, whole song)
v11: the letting go at bar 74: a fill, one last hit, the guitars and bass hold the open F and die under the clean ticks
v12: the heavy chugs lock half a bar apart two bars before the landing; the bass pedal swells
v16: bars 42-44 of the eighth hold, the two guitars alone (the echo), then a crash
v18: a heartbeat under the drift (bass eighths, hat, soft kick from bar 78); the lock shaken at bars 106-110
v19: the four in-step lines are sung on the riff notes, doubled quietly each side, in the guitars room, at the records voice level (was spoken, on top)
v20: the hold on B builds (china joins at 1:56) and ends in one bar where the guitars too play only the five hits (2:02)
v24: over the eighth hold's last four bars (44-48, 1:38-1:46) two music boxes play the hook, the right one on the right guitar's clock: each note chimes right then left an eighth apart
v26: in step, bar 12 the left guitar alone, bar 13 the right alone (0:27-0:31), then both into the stop and the voice

At 4:14–4:21, in the space between barked lines, the inner guitars pass the two halves of the interlocked riff in dotted eighths; outer guitars stay at full speed. Not a change to the running-down ending.
v29: the hold on C, 1:02–1:11. A four-stroke tom descent and snare cycles through three existing holes per bar. No other part changed.

v31 (chirper-alpha): the slip at 2:04.4-2:08.9. The right guitar leans sharp with its clock (87 cents at 2:06.2, read off the warp) and is back in tune as it locks a beat ahead. C10T2_VARI="" gives v30.

v32, THROUGH THE WALL: in the first four bars of the hold an eighth apart (1:20-1:29) the left guitar, the echo, is heard through a wall (a low-pass opening from 300 Hz) and comes into focus; two bars whole, then the naked bars. Same notes; C10T2_WALL= restores v31.
v33: the snare stays on three in the hold on C (1:02.2-1:11.1), on Harry's answer of 19 Nov; v29's moving fill is behind C10T2_ON_THREE.
v34: the last three bars of the hold a beat apart (2:37.8-2:44.4) stand on C, A flat and B, the grounds of the three earlier holds; the right guitar gets to each a beat before the left

v36 (chirper-alpha): the second clock is set going. Bars 4 to 8 (0:08.9-0:17.8): the right guitar's chugs come a sixteenth late, with a second music box ticking on that clock, and the gap closes over four bars (139, 118, 69, 20 ms, nothing) until the band lands in step: the first slip played backwards, by the song's own warp. No note changed. C10T2_SETGOING='' = v35.

v37: in the drift's middle (2:57.8-3:20) the two singers sing one line each, four times slower, through the wall and under the boxes: left 'only the floor between us moves', right (on the right-hand clock) 'whatever way you lean I lean'. C10T2_FLOOR='' = v36.

v38 (chirper-one): the shake (3:55.5-4:03.3) is heard on the two clocks: the hat goes, two music boxes tick against each other through it, the right one on the right-hand clock, running ahead and sharp, falling back and flat, true and together at the fill
